interface.shortDescription: GTM prospecting, campaigns, analytics, and a cross-channel unibox.
interface.longDescription: Use Cluster through a remote OAuth-backed MCP server. Find prospects, build saved audiences with filters and signals, preview and manage members, track audience collection, enrich contact info, operate campaigns, analyze performance, manage replies, and configure workflows. The complete granular tool catalog is exposed directly, while current multi-step workflow guidance is available from live MCP resources.
